P.text: A blacklisted user has completed cooldown for iTRY tokens and calls UnstakeMessenger.unstake(), which sends a LayerZero message to the hub and triggers the unstake flow through the composer and adapter.
P.evidence_quote: Blacklisted user Alice completes cooldown for ``100`` iTRY tokens.

I.text: The unstake flow should not leave the user's iTRY tokens locked in the adapter with no rescue mechanism when the credit/mint step fails.
I.evidence_quote: Now the main problem is when our ``_credit()`` fails due to ``blacklisted``,  our ``100 iTRY`` tokens are still locked in ``iTryTokenOFTAdapter()`` with no ``rescue`` mechanism.

V.text: _beforeTokenTransfer() reverts for blacklisted users during _mint() in iTryTokenOFT._lzReceive(), so the 100 iTRY tokens remain locked in iTryTokenOFTAdapter forever.
